about.title: USD to EUR Calculator - Live Exchange Rate & Currency Conversion
about.description: Quickly convert US Dollars (USD) to Euros (EUR) using live market exchange rates. Enter any amount, apply fees or margins, and see the converted value instantly—ideal for travelers, shoppers, and international transfers.

howTo.title: How to Use the USD to EUR Calculator

steps.title: Enter Amount in USD
steps.description: Type the dollar amount you want to convert to euros.

steps.title: Use Live Rate or Custom Rate
steps.description: Choose the real-time rate or input a bank/FX provider's quoted rate.

steps.title: Add Fees (Optional)
steps.description: Include card/transfer fees or FX margins to estimate the final received amount.

steps.title: View EUR Result
steps.description: See the converted EUR amount with a clear breakdown of rate and fees.

faq.q: Why is my bank's rate different?
faq.a: Banks and card networks often add a spread on top of the mid-market rate plus fees.
No. FX rates fluctuate throughout the day based on global markets.

faq.q: How can I get a better rate?
faq.a: Compare multiple providers and avoid unnecessary markups or weekend conversions.
You can add fees manually to model what your bank/card will charge.

faq.q: Why doesn't the result match my card statement exactly?
faq.a: Merchants may use Dynamic Currency Conversion and providers may apply different markups, weekend pricing, or rounding, causing small differences from mid‑market estimates.
